0022600153.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (4-1, 1st in the Northwest) visit the Houston Rockets (5-1, 2nd in the Southwest, 0.5 games back) for the Thunder's sixth game of the season, with Oklahoma City on a one-game losing streak after going 4-1 over its last five. Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Houston is without Alperen Sengun (back soreness), Reed Sheppard (back), and Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Thunder won their 2025-26 season series 2-1, though the most recent meeting went to Houston, 112-106, in Oklahoma City on February 7, 2026.
